items.evidence: IBM measures five key financial metrics, and in 2018, added a relative Return on Invested Capital (ROIC) modifier to the PSU program
Operating Net Income | Measures our profit and operational success
Operating Cash Flow* | Important measure of our ability to reinvest and return value to stockholders
Operating EPS | Measures operating profitability on a per share basis
Free Cash Flow | Important measure of our ability to reinvest and return value to stockholders over multiple years
The modifier is based on IBM's ROIC performance over the three-year performance period, relative to the S&P 500 Index

equal_split.evidence: The PSU score is calculated as a weighted average of results against targets for Operating EPS (70%) and Free Cash Flow (30%).
